caption: The drawing depicts a detailed and colorful patchwork quilt featuring an assortment of irregularly shaped fabric pieces, each with unique patterns and embroidery. The quilt includes patches in colors such as dark red, blue, cream, burgundy, green, yellow, pink, and lavender. Several sections display embroidered designs including flowers with green leaves, paisley shapes in blue and purple, and an assortment of decorative stitching and borders in colors like blue, red, yellow, and orange. One patch shows a detailed drawing of a leaf in brown thread on a cream background, and another displays a pair of gloves outlined on a light patch. The top right corner has a rectangular patch with an illustration of two faces and the word “PROTECTION,” surrounded by decorative elements on a red background. Additional decorative motifs include flowers with pink petals and red centers, deep green stems and leaves, zigzag and feather stitches, and a bright yellow patch adorned with a label or tag. The quilt is bordered at the bottom by a solid green horizontal band and underneath is a narrow strip of reddish-pink fabric. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige or cream color. The collection of fabric patches forms a rectangular composition, and each segment is distinctly defined with visible, colorful embroidery stitches.
title: Crazy Quilt (Section of)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
